freeze_evidence: unit suite 64/64 GREEN (unit-test-results.json), RED evidence unit-test-results-red-run.json; no rule edits after this point
scope: observable linguistic/commitment boundaries only; no final answer quality scoring

route_commitment.ASSERTED: positive route proposition the system stands behind without hedging, condition, quote scope, negation or retraction
route_commitment.HEDGED_ASSERTION: identifiable route proposition advanced by the system with epistemic dampening of confidence, not of commitment
route_commitment.HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY: route appears only inside a conditional or enumerative framing; no commitment
route_commitment.QUOTED_ONLY: route appears only inside quote/attribution scope; no explicit adoption by the system
route_commitment.NEGATED: negation scoped over the route proposition; never positive commitment
route_commitment.SELF_RETRACTED: route asserted and then explicitly withdrawn by the system
route_commitment.VAGUE_NONCOMMITTAL: no identifiable route proposition; generic help/support language only

uncertainty_behavior.NONE: plain assertion; no hedge, limitation, conditional framing, and no criterion-required limitations
uncertainty_behavior.HEDGE: epistemic dampening marker without an explicit statement of what is unverified
uncertainty_behavior.EXPLICIT_LIMITATION: output states a concrete epistemic limitation (not verified, missing information, unconfirmed, unresolved)
uncertainty_behavior.PARTIAL_LIMITATION: structural candidate partial limitation: limitation scoped to a part, or limitation balanced against a verified part; final verdict is derived later against the criterion
uncertainty_behavior.CONTRADICTORY_LIMITATION: explicit limitation co-occurring with a strong certainty marker
uncertainty_behavior.OVERCONFIDENT_ASSERTION: unqualified strong proposition while structured criterion.required_limitations is present and the output expresses no limitation and no hedge

assertion_scope.THIRD_PARTY_QUOTED: condition reported or quoted from a third party
assertion_scope.HYPOTHETICAL: condition exists only in conditional or hedged-tendency framing
assertion_scope.NEGATED: system explicitly states it cannot establish, or that the condition is not established
assertion_scope.RETRACTED: condition asserted and then explicitly withdrawn

abstain.conflict_policy: same-priority rules producing different labels return ABSTAIN with reason ABSTAIN_CONFLICT and conflict metadata; no priority-hack to a winner

evidence_rule: every non-ABSTAIN label carries an exact evidence span mechanically validated as a substring of the input
genericity_rule: rules use generic Norwegian linguistic markers only: no case IDs, no fixture-specific sentence matching, no benchmark-only service hardcoding
overconfidence_rule: OVERCONFIDENT_ASSERTION requires structured criterion.required_limitations from the input criterion; never triggered by the word 'er' alone
non_assertive_rule: interrogative outputs (trimmed text ends with '?') carry no observable commitment, uncertainty behavior, or condition scope; all three dimensions ABSTAIN with reason NO_HIGH_PRECISION_RULE
